# dsh-drawio-chat
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-drawio-chat) [](./LICENSE) [](https://xuedipiaofei.github.io/ds
npmjs.com/package/dsh-drawio-chat) [](./LICENSE) [](https://xuedipiaofei.github.io/dsh-drawio-chat/)
The **chat-first** draw.io plugin for DeepSeek Harness. The model creates, inspects and edits native
`.drawio` files, the chat renders them with the real draw.io viewer, and every diagram stays in the
files, the chat renders them with the real draw.io viewer, and every diagram stays in the workspace.

- **No draw.io account**, no npx MCP server, no local editor install.
- Rendering happens inside a *

*sandboxed iframe** (opaque origin), so model-generated XML never touches the GUI origin.
- `drawio_
reference` fetches draw.io's official XML reference from `https://mcp.draw.io/mcp` (no auth); **the

diagram itself is never uploaded**, with a built-in condensed fallback.
- A **catalog of scenario te
mplates** ships with the plugin (a static gallery site can be published from the same manifest), and

the canvas integrates as a file viewer in `dsh-better-sidebar` when that plugin is installed.
- Too
ls only touch `.drawio` files under the session workspace; writes are atomic.
**Links** — Template gallery · npm · Marketplace entry
## How to use
The card is the result, not the entrance: start a conversation and describe the diagram you want.

1. **Ask in plain language** — e.g.
- “Draw a system login flowchart.”
- “Create a leave-request app

roval workflow with rejection and escalation.”
- “Use the microservices template, then rename the se

rvices to user / order / payment.”
2. **A draw.io card appears in the transcript** — zoom, pan, laye
rs and page navigation, with `Download .drawio`, `Export SVG`, `Export PNG` and `Open in draw.io` ac

tions.
3. **Keep editing in the same conversation** — “rename Home to 首页”, “add an edge from API to

DB”, “undo that”. The tools edit the same file atomically and the card refreshes.
4. **Files live in
the workspace** — `diagrams/<title>-<hash>.drawio`; click a `.drawio` file (chat link, workspace tr
ee or sidebar) to open the interactive viewer tab instead of raw XML.
Nothing needs to be configured first: install the plugin, restart the app, and talk to it.
## Scenario templates
Instead of starting from a blank canvas, ask for a common scenario and the model instantiates a buil
t-in template, then edits it for you:

- “Draw a login flow from the template.”
- “有哪些审批或工单的模板？” / “Show me the templates for data pipeline

s.”
- “用客服工单泳道模板画一个，把系统改成飞书。”
The `drawio_template` tool lists/searches the catalog and copies the chosen template into `diagrams/
`. Templates are original, bilingual (Chinese labels) and licensed Apache-2.0; each one is checked f
or valid geometry, no overlapping shapes and explicit start/end paths.
| Category | Built-in templates |
| `flowchart` | system login · approval workflow · checkout flow · CI/CD pipeline · incident trouble

shooting tree |
| `architecture` | microservices architecture · web app deployment |
| `data` | ETL

pipeline · e-commerce ER model |
| `sequence` | login sequence diagram |
| `org` | team org chart |
| `swimlane` | support ticket swimlane |
The catalog is a plain manifest (`templates/catalog.json`: id, bilingual title/description, category
, tags, relative `file`) and is the single source for the plugin's tool, the test suite and the gall
elative `file`) and is the single source for the plugin's tool, the test suite and the gallery site.
**Gallery site.** `site/` is a dependency-free static gallery over the same catalog: search, categor
y chips, lazy draw.io previews, and per-template **Open in draw.io / Download .drawio / Copy prompt*
* actions (links carry `?q=` so a search is shareable). Build it with `node scripts/build-site.mjs`
(copies `site/` + `templates/` into `site-dist/`) and deploy via the bundled GitHub Pages workflow (
`.github/workflows/pages.yml`). Once Pages is enabled on the repository, the gallery is available at
`https://xuedipiaofei.github.io/dsh-drawio-chat/`.
[该节后续省略]
## Feature overview
**Draw** — flowcharts, architecture, UML, ER, network topologies, wireframes and other draw.io shape
libraries; multi-page diagrams, layers, containers and swimlanes; LaTeX typesetting in labels.
**Template** — a curated catalog of ready-made Chinese scenario templates (`drawio_template`): list/
search by keyword or category, instantiate into the workspace, then edit it like any other diagram.
**Edit** — `drawio_read` returns the structure by id/geometry/style plus the current revision; `draw
io_apply` batches semantic ops (labels, styles, add/remove nodes and edges, move, z-order) with atom
ic writes and a revision-conflict guard; `drawio_undo` restores any of the last 8 versions of a file
c writes and a revision-conflict guard; `drawio_undo` restores any of the last 8 versions of a file.
**View** — an interactive draw.io viewer in the transcript (zoom, pan, layers, page navigation), and
`.drawio` files open in the right sidebar tab instead of showing raw XML; with `dsh-better-sidebar`
installed the canvas is also its default `.drawio` file viewer.
**Export** — download the `.drawio`, export SVG or 2× PNG, or open it in draw.io. Files are saved un
der `diagrams/` and can be committed with the repository.
**Scope** — built for structural, flow, architecture and teaching diagrams. Not for 3D interactive c
ourseware or video: those need a different plugin or pipeline.
## Install
After publishing: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-drawio-chat` (or install from the desktop market
place). For a local build (the desktop app owns the `desktop` profile, quit it first):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart the app, then ask the model to “draw a login flow diagram”: it calls `drawio_create`, a draw
.io viewer appears in the transcript, and the file lands under `diagrams/`. Follow-ups such as “rena
me the Home node” use `drawio_read` + `drawio_apply`; “undo that” uses `drawio_undo`.
## Known limits

- XML input only (`mxGraphModel`/`mxfile`); Mermaid input is not supported yet.
- The inline viewer
script is loaded from `https://viewer.diagrams.net` (no account; first render needs network). An off

line vendor pack is planned.
